## Submission checklist / 提交检查

- [ ] I have the right to publish this material. / 我有权公开提交这些内容。
- [ ] Private data, credentials and unauthorized material have been removed. / 已移除个人信息、密钥和未授权材料。
- [ ] Source language and original expression are preserved where material. / 已保留重要内容的原始语言和表达。
- [ ] Original text, translation, summary, inference and conclusion are distinguishable. / 已区分原文、译文、摘要、推断和结论。
- [ ] Machine-facing paths, IDs, labels and enum values use English. / 机器使用的路径、ID、标签和枚举值采用英文。
- [ ] Important external claims have verifiable sources or are marked unverified. / 重要外部主张附有来源或标记为未核查。
- [ ] Material AI assistance is disclosed. / 已披露实质性AI参与。
- [ ] I reviewed the final public diff. / 我已审阅最终公开diff。
- [ ] This PR does not independently perform protected L4 operations. / 本PR未让AI独立执行受保护的L4操作。
